verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server plus a full REST/OpenAPI API that let agents run trends, funnels, retention and HogQL queries, ship feature flags, and build insights (posthog-docs-2, posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-19/24, posthog-probe-4, posthog-probe-3), which covers most of an agent-driven dashboard workflow. However, no citation explicitly confirms an agent can assemble/save a full dashboard (not just insights) end-to-end via MCP, and a hands-on report describes the LLM/AI query assistant failing on a basic SQL-based cohort task and causing severe UI slowdowns (posthog-comm-8), indicating real friction in agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documented example of an agent creating/saving a complete dashboard via MCP/API, and independent confirmation that MCP-driven query/insight creation is reliable.
